title: NASA’s Perseverance Offers Clues to Protect Crews From Mars Dust
caption:
NASA’s Perseverance rover has been tracking the tiny, clingy dust particles on Mars that could pose a real risk to future human explorers. By measuring how they stick to spacesuit materials, engineers are learning how to keep our astronauts safe.

Source: Nasa - NASA’s Perseverance Offers Clues to Protect Crews From Mars Dust
